---
title: Audio and video paths
---

```video
src: 'javascript:HOSTILE_VSRC()'
title: Clip
poster: 'https://evil.example/HOSTILE.png'
```

```audio
src: 'https://evil.example/HOSTILE.mp3'
title: Sound
```

```video
src: 'data:video/mp4;base64,AAAA'
title: Clip
poster: 'javascript:HOSTILE_POSTER()'
```
